signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(dlc, lt)), SUB(RANK(DELTA(RATIO(dvc, at), 1)), RANK(DELTA(RATIO(oancf, at), 1))))

signals.name: Rollover Maintenance Cash Strain
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(RATIO(MIN(dltis, dltr), at), 1), SUB(RANK(RATIO(dp, at)), RANK(RATIO(oancf, at))))

signals.name: Lagged Debt Gross Profit Efficiency
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(LAG(RATIO(dltis, at), 1), 1), SUB(RANK(GROWTH(SUB(revt, cogs), 1)), RANK(GROWTH(lt, 1))))

signals.name: Buyback Cash Acceleration Discipline
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(RATIO(prstkc, at), 1), SUB(RANK(ACCEL(RATIO(oancf, at))), RANK(RATIO(dltis, at))))

signals.name: Capitalized Intangible Yield x Intensity
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5)))), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)))

signals.name: Productive Intangible Overhead
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(oibdp, xsga)), IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), xsga)))

signals.name: Brand-Customer Intangible Payoff
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(oiadp, sale)), IND_RANK(RATIO(MUL(GROWTH(sale, 1), ADD(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xad, 0), 5), SUB(COALESCE(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)))), at)))

signals.name: Cash-Funded Intangible Compounder
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at)))

signals.name: Durable Intangible Profitability
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), MUL(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(oibdp, at), 5)))))

signals.name: Signed Intangible Profit Validation
signals.expression: WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(oibdp, at), RATIO(ADD(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0)), at)), 1)

signals.name: Lagged Intangible Margin Inflection
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1), 1)), IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1)))

signals.name: Recognized Intangible Margin Validation
signals.expression: WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(oiadp, sale), RATIO(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), at)), 1)

signals.name: Intangible Profitability Acceleration
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(ACCEL(RATIO(oibdp, at))), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at)))

signals.name: Intangible Harvest Operating Leverage
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3)))))

signals.name: Internal Intangibles over Goodwill Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(oibdp, at)), IND_RANK(SUB(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at), RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at))))

signals.name: Cash Payoff to Intangible Ramp
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(ADD(MA(RATIO(oancf, sale), 3), ACCEL(RATIO(oancf, sale))), 1)), IND_RANK(LAG(TREND(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3), 1)))

signals.name: Gross-to-Operating Intangible Conversion
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(TREND(RATIO(oibdp, SUB(revt, cogs)), 3), 1)), IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), sale), 1)))

signals.name: Goodwill-Light Intangible Cash High
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(TS_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, sale), 3), 5)), IND_RANK(SUB(RATIO(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), at), RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at))))

signals.name: Debt-Light Self-Funded Intangible Ramp
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(oancf, ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3)))), MUL(IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(COALESCE(xint, 0), sale), 3)))))

signals.name: Cash-Validated Intangible Turnover Improvement
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, sale), 3)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(sale, ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3))), 1), 1)))

signals.name: Goodwill Margin Decay
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)))

signals.name: Rising Intangible Spend Absorption
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 1), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 1), 1)))

signals.name: Profitable Intangible Reinvestment Share
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), ADD(oibdp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 1)))

signals.name: Intangible Gross-Margin Upgrade
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt), 1), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1))))

signals.name: Lagged Intangible Profit Dollar Payoff
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(oibdp, 1), at), 1)), IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1)))

signals.name: Intangible Cost-Mix Upgrade
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(SUB(TREND(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3), TREND(RATIO(cogs, revt), 3)), 1)))

signals.name: Acquired Intangible Cash Decay
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(TREND(RATIO(oancf, sale), 3)), 1)), IND_RANK(SUB(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at), RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at))))

signals.name: Profitable Intangible Investment Mix
signals.expression: WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(oibdp, sale), COALESCE(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), ADD(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), ABS(DELTA(at, 1)))), 0)), 1)

signals.name: Self-Funded Intangible Reinvestment
signals.expression: WINSOR(MUL(COALESCE(RATIO(SUB(oancf, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), ADD(ABS(oibdp), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 0), COALESCE(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), ADD(ABS(oancf), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 0)), 1)

signals.name: Intangible Expense Productivity Mix
signals.expression: WINSOR(MUL(COALESCE(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(dp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 0), COALESCE(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), ADD(dp, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 0)), 1)

signals.name: Sustained Intangible Margin Breakout
signals.expression: WINSOR(MUL(SUB(RATIO(oibdp, sale), MA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 5)), MA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 5)), 1)

signals.name: Expensed Intangible Recognition Gap
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), 1), sale)), 1)))

signals.name: Intangible Cash Dropthrough
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(DELTA(oancf, 1), at), RATIO(DELTA(sale, 1), at)), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible Overhead Discipline
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(MA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(TREND(RATIO(SUB(xsga, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 3)), 1))))

signals.name: Profitability Outruns Intangible Spend
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(SUB(TS_RANK(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 5), TS_RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 5)), 1)))

signals.name: Acquisition Platform Internal Innovation
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(TREND(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt), 3), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at), MA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3)), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible Demand Resilience
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(sale, TS_MAX(sale, 5)), 1))))

signals.name: Goodwill Demand Drawdown
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(sale, TS_MAX(sale, 5))), 1))))

signals.name: Research-to-Market Profit Transition
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 3), at), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(TREND(RATIO(COALESCE(xad, 0), sale), 3), 1))))

signals.name: Goodwill-to-Internal Rotation Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(TREND(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(TREND(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at), 3)), 1))))

signals.name: Recognized Intangible Amortization Cash Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(oibdp, oiadp), sale), 1))))

signals.name: Gross-Margin Floor Intangible Moat
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt), 5))))

signals.name: Intangible Cost-Base Productivity
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), ADD(cogs, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), ADD(cogs, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible Cash Moat Expansion
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt), 5)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(oancf, 1), at), 1))))

signals.name: Balanced Intangible Commercialization Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xad, 0), COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0))), sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(ABS(SUB(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xad, 0), COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0)), sale)))), 1))))

signals.name: Recognized Customer Asset Cash Retention
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(sale, TS_MAX(sale, 5)), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible Neglect Demand Failure
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(sale, TS_MAX(sale, 5))), 1))))

signals.name: Hybrid Intangible Stack Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 1))))

signals.name: Cost-Stable Intangible Moat
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(cogs, revt), 5)))))

signals.name: Intangible Gross Cash Conversion
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), MUL(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt), 5)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, SUB(revt, cogs)), 1))))

signals.name: Goodwill Debt Coverage Failure
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(COALESCE(xint, 0), sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(oibdp, sale)), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible Spend Absorption Coverage
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(ABS(oibdp), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)))), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 1)))

signals.name: Intangible Fixed-Charge Coverage
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, ADD(ABS(oibdp), ADD(COALESCE(xint, 0), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))))), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at)))

signals.name: Goodwill with Internal Reinvestment Neglect
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale)), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(oibdp, sale)), 1))))

signals.name: Recognized Intangible Renewal Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), 1), at), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 1))))

signals.name: Lagged Intangible Dual Inflection
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 3), at), 1)), SUMRANK(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1), 1), WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(oancf, 1), at), 1)))

signals.name: Organic Intangible Profit Minus Levered Goodwill
signals.expression: SUB(MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at))), MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(COALESCE(xint, 0), sale), 1))))

signals.name: Research-to-Brand Gross Cash Payoff
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(LAG(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 3), at), 1)), MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(COALESCE(xad, 0), sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, SUB(revt, cogs)), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible-Adjusted Gross Cash Yield
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(oancf, ADD(at, TS_SUM(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 5))), RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), revt)), 1)))

signals.name: Intangible Renewal Sales Validation
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(MUL(GROWTH(sale, 1), ADD(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(SUB(intan, COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), 0), 1), at))), 1)))

signals.name: Goodwill Interest-Covered Profit
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(oibdp, sale), RATIO(COALESCE(xint, 0), sale)), 1)))

signals.name: Profitable Hiring Restraint
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(oibdp, emp)), IND_RANK(NEG(GROWTH(emp, 1))))

signals.name: Capex Roll-Off Cash Resilience
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(capx, at), 3))))

signals.name: Capacity Growth Profit Productivity Fade
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(GROWTH(ppent, 1)), IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, ppent), 1))))

signals.name: Intangible Build Profit Fade
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(intan, at), 1)), IND_RANK(SUB(IND_ADJ(RATIO(pi, at)), DELTA(RATIO(pi, at), 1))))

signals.name: Lean Inventory Margin Expansion
signals.expression: SUMRANK(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1), NEG(DELTA(RATIO(invt, sale), 1)))

signals.name: Unconverted Capex Profit Fade
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(LAG(MA(RATIO(capx, at), 3), 1)), MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 1)))))

signals.name: Levered Margin Fade
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at), 1)), MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)))))

signals.name: Inventory Accrual Profit Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(SUB(RATIO(ib, at), RATIO(oancf, at))), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(invt, sale), 1)))

signals.name: Cash Generator Equity Issue Red Flag
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(che, at), 1))))

signals.name: Gross Margin Inventory Efficiency
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), sale)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(invt, sale))))

signals.name: Hiring Pause Margin Leverage
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 1)), IND_RANK(NEG(GROWTH(emp, 1))))

signals.name: Margin Durability Inventory Stability
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 3)), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 3))), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(invt, sale), 3)))))

signals.name: Profitable Inventory Intensity Deceleration
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, sale), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(ACCEL(RATIO(invt, sale)))))

signals.name: Post Capex Cash Payback
